item.description: The deduplication logic in Up2k is not properly handling duplicate file detection, causing test failures in test_dedup.py. The system returns "J2EOT" instead of proper duplicate handling responses.
item.contract: When duplicate files are detected, the system should return a 422 Unprocessable Entity response with a message indicating the file already exists at a different location, rather than returning "J2EOT". The duplicate detection logic should properly track file hashes and prevent redundant uploads.

item.description: The move/rename functionality in Up2k is not properly implemented, causing failures in test_mv.py with "J2EOT" error. The move operation should handle cross-directory moves correctly.
item.contract: The move operation should support cross-directory moves and properly update file references in the filesystem and database. It should return a 201 Created response when successful, not "J2EOT".

item.description: Hook execution logic is incomplete or incorrectly implemented, causing test failures in test_hooks.py with "J2EOT" errors. The hook processing system is not properly handling relocation logic.
item.contract: Hook scripts should be executed properly when files are uploaded or modified, and the system should correctly process relocation directives from hooks. The hook execution should return proper responses rather than "J2EOT".

item.description: Directory key validation and thumbnail generation logic in Up2k is not correctly handling access control for protected content, causing test failures in test_dots.py.
item.contract: Directory key validation should properly restrict access to protected content based on directory keys. Thumbnail generation should render appropriate access denied messages (e.g., ">e403") when access is denied, rather than failing silently.
